calls.title: Second Nature + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion addressed Growth Book's pricing structures for both cloud and self-hosted enterprise solutions to meet the budget needs of Second Nature AI. Key highlights included the Pro plan's cost of $40 per user per month for up to 50 users, which would total approximately $2,000 monthly for Second Nature AI's 30 users. The self-hosted minimum cost is $50,000 per year for 10 licenses, deemed advantageous for security and flexibility. Nir expressed interest in starting with the Pro plan to evaluate its value. The conversation also explored potential discounts related to a joint case study. Misunderstandings about the company identities were clarified, emphasizing the need for clear communication.

# Second Nature & GrowthBook | First Meeting
Date: 2026-09-17 | Duration: 13.170000076293945m

## Summary
Nir requested GrowthBook enterprise pricing while moving from the static offering, specifically asking about SSO, role management, and a formal offer for 50 seats. Marcel explained that pricing consists of a platform fee plus user seats, at around $1,000 per user per year, and confirmed that enterprise includes feature flags, experiments, training, and customer support without extra costs for those capabilities. Nir currently uses static for feature gates and does not expect experimentation to be a priority over the next 3–6 months. Marcel agreed to provide both cloud and self-hosted pricing, including technical and feature details, customer success, and onboarding information. Nir expects to make a decision in about one week, will compare the offers, and plans to show the self-hosted option to the startup founder. Marcel will follow up and remain available for technical questions.

## Keywords
feature gates, enterprise pricing, GrowthBook, SSO, role management, self-hosted solution
